newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-GREEKS HOPE PARIS ST GERMAIN WILL STAY OUT OF FORM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GREEKS HOPE PARIS ST GERMAIN WILL STAY OUT OF FORM.

text.p: AEK Athens, the opponent of Paris St Germain in March's European cupwinners' cup quarter finals, said the French club was out of form and this will show in a European Supercup match against Juventus on Wednesday.

"If we played today with PSG we would be on equal ground. I hope that until March we will maintain our good form while PSG will be in the same condition as they are now," AEK coach Petros Ravousis said.
AEK come from a 2-0 victory on Monday against Greek first division leaders Olympiakos and have the best scoring record in the championship with 33 goals after 15 rounds.

"We will be watching Paris St Germain on television against Juventus. But this match won't be used to draw any final conclusions about PSG because they are just back from a break and are hit by many injuries," another AEK official said.
The Supercup first leg, to be played at Parc des Princes, was extensively covered in Greek sports papers citing injury news, players' comments and freezing temperatures in Paris.
